meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 装上后，Codex 在成功调用 apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑类工具后会自动收到 comment-checker 反馈；若被标记为警告，该反馈会阻塞流程，需先修复或解释被标记的注释才能继续。
howto.when: 编辑类工具调用成功后触发（PostToolUse 钩子）。非编辑工具被忽略；缺少检查器二进制时不输出任何反馈。

say.text: 看看刚才那条被标记的注释有什么问题
say.note: 会读取 comment-checker 的警告

say.text: 把这次 edit 里被警告的注释改掉
say.note: 修复后阻塞反馈才解除

say.text: 解释一下这个注释警告，先不改代码

howto.what_en: Once installed, Codex gets comment-checker feedback after successful apply_patch, write, edit and similar edit-like calls. A flagged warning is blocking: Codex must fix or explain the comment before moving on.
howto.when_en: Triggers after a successful edit-like tool call (PostToolUse hook). Non-edit tools are ignored; if the checker binary is missing, no feedback is emitted.

say_en.text: Check what's wrong with that flagged comment
Fix the flagged comment from that edit
say_en.note: Blocking feedback clears after the fix

say_en.text: Explain that comment warning, don't change code yet
say_en.note: Explaining is allowed instead of fixing
